final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is a reinterpretation and narrowing of the same record: aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support a bounded launch-readiness statement, but the governing policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance for material limitations affecting named launch use cases or contractual customer segments. That makes an unqualified or even caveated compliance finding too strong on this evidence. The proportional conclusion is that the certification case may be arguable as a business or readiness posture, but compliance remains unresolved and therefore suspicious.
